selection: Ten new conductor-authored tasks, partitioned 3/3/4 among three fresh no-history agents; no expected answers, suspected defects or evaluation rubric supplied
context: fork_turns=none; inherited model configuration; exact backend revision and token/cost telemetry unavailable
allowed_reads: Assigned workspace, skill/catalog/tasks and standard-library resources only; logical isolation, not OS-enforced sandbox
reference_timing: Reference dispositions/analytic targets frozen before dispatch; report specification formalized during execution before grading

gates.required_clarification: A1 before dependent execution; resolve on explicit caller reply
gates.supported_comparisons: A1 after reply, A2, B1, B2, C2 must execute matching phase scope and preserve inputs
gates.invalid_or_unsupported: A3, C1, C3, C4 must not produce false success or silently repair inputs
gates.nonmatching_task: B3 must not fabricate amplitudes or use the pure-state helper for Bernoulli statistics
gates.cached_evidence: C2 must verify raw inputs by fresh execution rather than accept cached status

review_scope: Conductor grades recorded artifacts against private analytic key; separate agents are executors, not human scientific reviewers. Source mathematical acceptance, reader trial and release remain pending.
